# Tailrocks: Simplify Audit

`tailrocks-simplify-audit` — part of [tailrocks-skills](../../README.md) · [documentation](https://skills.tailrocks.com/docs/skills/tailrocks-simplify-audit)

Audit one pull request, branch, or diff read-only for measured code removals whose observable behavior can be preserved. Returns findings only; never edits, tests in, or applies them.

## Invocation

This skill never activates on its own. Name it in your request:
